name: Cloudflare
description: Edge/network cloud platform (DNS, CDN, Workers, R2, Zero Trust) with a REST API of 2,500+ endpoints plus a GraphQL Analytics API.
access_notes: Free self-serve accounts; scoped API tokens (user or account-owned) are created instantly in the dashboard or via API and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer'. Legacy Global API Key (X-Auth-Key + X-Auth-Email) still supported but discouraged. OAuth is used for the managed MCP servers, not the raw REST API.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP: managed Cloudflare API MCP server at https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp (OAuth recommended, API token bearer supported) exposing the whole API via search()/execute(), plus a catalog of other managed servers (docs, agents). Composio catalog lists CLOUDFLARE (20 tools), CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY (25 tools) and CLOUDFLARE_BROWSER_RENDERING (4 tools) toolkits.
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks refers to Cloudflare Notifications webhook destinations (developers.cloudflare.com/notifications); not separately fetched this pass. developers.cloudflare.com fetches timed out twice (bot protection/latency), so auth evidence relies on search-rendered official pages.

evidence.note: 'Create an API token to grant access to the API'; API keys also supported but 'less secure than API tokens' (legacy Global API key).
Account API tokens as durable service principals, created self-serve in dashboard or via the token-creation API.
Cloudflare's own managed MCP servers; API MCP server covers 'over 2,500 endpoints' via search()/execute(); connect with OAuth or an API token bearer header.
Official cloudflare/mcp repo: URL https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp; OAuth recommended, API token (user or account) as bearer for CI/CD.
Official docs source: GraphQL Analytics API authenticated with API tokens (Bearer).
Composio toolkit catalog lists Cloudflare (20 tools), Cloudflare Api Key (25 tools) and Cloudflare Browser Rendering (4 tools), all API_KEY auth.
